_about: Sound + haptics spec (rec 10). Every timeline step may name one cue with "sfx". The golden pages synthesise placeholder cues with WebAudio (turn on with ?sound=1 or the speaker button) so timing can be judged; the app replaces them with produced audio of the same name, length and loudness. Haptics are navigator.vibrate patterns (ms) on mobile. All cues respect the OS mute switch and the in-game sound setting; nothing plays under prefers-reduced-motion except the tick and ding.
loudness: -16 LUFS integrated for the mix; cues peak at -6 dBFS; the stamp is the loudest cue in the game

offer-ding.when: an offer lands on the rail
offer-ding.sound: small brass bell, bright, 300 ms decay

gap-snap.sound: wooden click + a short rising tone; higher pitch the smaller the gap

clock-tick.when: your face runs below the warning line (30 s, then 10 s)
clock-tick.sound: dry mechanical tick once per second, faster under 10 s

coin-drain.when: a coin falls off your pile while you think
coin-drain.sound: single soft coin drop into water, very quiet

stamp.sound: heavy wax-and-wood stamp thud, low body (80 Hz) + paper slap

card-flip.when: a sealed limit card turns over
card-flip.sound: card swish then a soft paper land; her card lands 150 ms later than yours feels right

reveal-sting.when: the zone splits and 'left on the table' appears
reveal-sting.sound: two-note sting: warm major for your part, a lower note for hers

coin-tick.when: each coin lands in a counter during a count-up
coin-tick.sound: short bright coin tick, pitch rises through the count

trophy.when: the traded item lands in the cabinet (pending)
trophy.sound: glass cabinet door + a velvet thump

letter.when: a rival's letter lands in the Bay
